explanation.headline: Bivalirudin is not on FDA's shortage list; Corvale General has 12.7 days on hand and Corvale East has 30.8 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include bivalirudin as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 136 vials of the 250 mg injection with a daily use of 10.7 vials, giving 12.7 days on hand.
Corvale East holds 270 vials of the 250 mg injection with a daily use of 8.8 vials, giving 30.8 days on hand.
The rule‑based best option is to buy from Accord Healthcare, Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today.
Accord Healthcare's label names no plant we could place, so the manufacturing site cannot be verified from the label.
A Dr. Reddy's label lists Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) as a registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2024-07-25.
Check whether the Accord product can be sourced from a registered facility with an acceptable inspection history.
